videos.title: “I Made It Happen With Zero Cosign!” Chella Talks His Global Success | Trending
videos.headline: “I Made It Happen With Zero Cosign!” Chella Talks His Global Success | Trending
videos.description:
Chella is not holding back! 🔥

The singer and songwriter joins Paschal on Trending for a revealing conversation about his music, growing success, unique sound, and his expectations ahead of the 18th Headies.

In this interview, Chella makes some statements about the Headies Next Rated category, explaining why he believes he deserves a spot ahead of Mavo and Fido. He also declares himself the GOAT, speaks about his Digital Artist of the Year nomination alongside Wizkid and Asake, and shares why he believes his achievements deserve even greater recognition.

He takes us through the story behind his breakout hit ‘My Darling’, how his collaboration with Tanzanian superstar Diamond Platnumz came about, the success of ‘Loyal’, his creative process, and why he refuses to compromise his individuality and unique style.

Chella also opens up about his family, being different in the music industry, his ambitions, and what people should expect from him next.

Plus, he takes on Money Moves by MoneyPoint, answering tough choices and reacting to what people are saying about him online.

Is Chella really the GOAT? Does he deserve to be Next Rated? Watch the full conversation and let us know what you think in the comments!

 Welcome to Trending, Africa’s biggest entertainment show.
